title: Large Enriched Germanium Experiment for Neutrinoless BB Decay
text: The Large Enriched Germanium Experiment for Neutrinoless ββ Decay (LEGEND) is a physics experiment located at the Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS) in Italy. LEGEND is a phased experiment searching for neutrinoless double beta decay (0νββ) in 76Ge. The LEGEND collaboration combines the expertise and technology of the MAJORANA and GERDA experiments, currently consisting of over 50 institutions from across the globe.
